2609.00078.title: RW-LoRA: Communication-Efficient Decentralized LoRA Fine-Tuning via Random Walks
2609.00078.paper_summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA have become a standard approach for adapting large foundation models. Adopting fine-tuning to distributed settings faces several challenges. Most existing distributed LoRA methods rely on centralized aggregation, and gossip-based decentralized LoRA requires repeated synchronization among multiple model copies. Both methods incur significant communication overhead and introduce errors due to simultaneous aggregation of multiple model updates. In this paper, we take a different perspective and propose a random-walk-based LoRA fine-tuning scheme. Instead of maintaining multiple model replicas, a single model token traverses the network and is updated sequentially using local fine-tuning objectives. This design eliminates the need for global synchronization, substantially reduces communication and computation costs, and avoids aggregation errors. We provide rigorous convergence guarantees for non-convex objectives under standard assumptions. Through empirical results on multiple NLP tasks and graph topologies, we show that the proposed method achieves competitive task performance with substantially less communication and computation than gossip-based LoRA.
2609.00078.paper_summary_zh: 參數高效的微調方法，如 LoRA，已成為調整大型基礎模型的標準方法。將微調應用於分散式環境面臨幾個挑戰。大多數現有的分散式 LoRA 方法依賴於集中式聚合，而基於 gossip 的去中心化 LoRA 需要在多個模型副本之間進行重複同步。這兩種方法都會產生顯著的通信開銷，並因同時聚合多個模型更新而引入錯誤。在本文中，我們採取不同的視角，提出了一種基於隨機漫步的 LoRA 微調方案。這種設計不再維護多個模型副本，而是通過一個單一的模型令牌在網絡中遍歷，並使用本地微調目標進行順序更新。這一設計消除了對全局同步的需求，顯著降低了通信和計算成本，並避免了聚合錯誤。我們在標準假設下為非凸目標提供了嚴格的收斂保證。通過對多個 NLP 任務和圖拓撲的實證結果，我們顯示所提出的方法在通信和計算上大幅減少的情況下，仍能達到具有競爭力的任務性能。
